Package hadur2.core.duel

Class ShadowAvoidance

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.duel.ShadowAvoidance
All Implemented Interfaces:
ShadowValue
final class ShadowAvoidance extends Object implements ShadowValue
The duel's seam between movement and gun for GUN-7: what a firing angle's bullet would save us, from the intervals movement publishes (MOVE-8). The gun and movement may not see each other, so the duel, which owns both, builds the gun's ShadowValue from movement's PlanIntervals and our bullets' shadow geometry (ShadowGain).

For each wave in the air with a published interval, a candidate bullet is fired from where the gun will be, along the angle, at the tick the shot would leave; the share of the interval it newly stops, taken of what was not stopped already, times the chance a bullet fired inside the interval hits us (PlanInterval.danger, which the surf computed with the shadows then in place), times the enemy bullet's damage, is what it saves. The danger is taken as spread evenly over the part of the interval nothing yet stops. A wave whose power came from an ambiguous split counts half, as the surf counts it (WAVE-3).

One instance is reused: prepare(java.util.List<hadur2.core.move.PlanInterval>, java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double, long) points it at the tick's plan. Work is bounded by the number of published intervals, at most the surf's look-ahead (two waves).
